name: rush-sr
description: Rush SR maintenance answers from the owner's manual, and lap analysis for AiM RaceStudio data.

interface.longDescription:
Ask about your Rush SR, or give it your lap data.

Maintenance: diagnose a symptom, look up a service interval, or get the steps for a procedure. Answers come from the public Rush SR owner's manual, with a link to the exact section.

Lap analysis: attach an AiM RaceStudio CSV export and get your lap times, your best and theoretical best lap, a comparison of two laps (braking points and corner minimum speeds), the sectors where a lap loses time, and a comparison of two drivers or sessions.

It reads what you give it and does arithmetic. It does not call a language model, stores nothing and needs no sign-in. The maintenance answers cover the Rush SR only.

Built by RUSH Auto Works Inc.
defaultPrompt: Why won't my Rush SR start? The dash shows N.
How often should I change the brake fluid on my Rush SR?
Analyze my laps from this RaceStudio export.
